name: agent402
description: Open-source MCP server: 500+ tools AI agents call and pay for per request over x402 or MPP, or free via proof-of-work for pure-compute tools.

interface.shortDescription: 500+ pay-per-call tools for AI agents over x402 or MPP
interface.longDescription: One MCP server with 500+ tools: web search and rendering, PDFs and OCR, SEC filings, market and crypto data, and utilities. The agent finds a tool with catalog.find and pays for that one call in USDC over x402 or MPP, by prepaid card credits, or free via proof-of-work for pure-compute tools. A failed call is never charged. Most tools are deterministic code; model-backed tools are marked as such.
defaultPrompt: Use Agent402.Tools to find a tool for this task and call it.
